title: Bind ordinary test detail and raw results to the originally indexed artifact
outcome: Ordinary test-run detail and raw-results responses either read facts from the originally indexed execution or report the original unavailable.
acceptance: After ordinary run refresh, deterministic replacement of a directory or file before another scan never makes detail or raw results return data from the replacement alongside the original summary.
The original unchanged ordinary directory still serves the expected detail and raw response bytes, with the preserved digest and existing response contracts.
